documents.content: Tenant isolation is enforced with RLS and app.tenant_id. Agents must not export or compare data across tenants. Privacy and cross-tenant isolation are mandatory.
On-page SEO requires unique title, single H1, descriptive meta description, and internal links to conversion pages. Technical SEO audits check crawlability.
Support triage: classify urgency, acknowledge within SLA, escalate billing and security issues to human approval. Ticket classification and response.
CRM follow-up: after 7 days of silence, send one value email; after 14 days, offer a short call; never invent tool execution without evidence. Lead nurturing cadence.
